Bengaluru ASHA workers protest for pay hike, 17 hospitalised

Seventeen ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) workers in Bengaluru have been hospitalised by the sixth day of their protest demanding a pay hike to Rs 15,000. The workers have been on strike for seven days.
